codes.misread-report: the report's headings were read shifted (two or more contests carry another office's candidates): none of the report is taken
codes.place-not-used: its place's records are not on the site
codes.no-source: no web link to the report or to the contest
codes.other-office: the contest carries another office's candidates
codes.official: the official results already hold the contest
codes.question: a ballot question, or ballot answers read as candidates
codes.misread-question: filed as a ballot question, but its title names an office (the report's rows were read shifted)
codes.state-office: a federal, state or circuit office: the state's results hold it whole
codes.not-reporters: an office its reporter does not report (the county's office, or another place's school board, on a city's page)
codes.not-a-contest: does not read as a contest (names, votes that add up, a winner who leads)
